description: A riptide III trident in a two-deep pool (x 0 to 10), the spin hitting things: a still husk (hit, bounced back); a husk passed within the launch tick (hit); an end crystal at the east wall (not living: the spin goes on against the wall); a crystal and a husk together (the husk is hit); up into a floating husk (bounced down); a husk killed just before (dying: hit); sprinting into a husk in the rain, from the ground (hit, the sprint goes on); then mounted on a horse in the middle of a spin (the horse is hit).

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
